name: Hecate
author: m10ust
description: Three-corner backups, set up by being asked for them. v0.0.6 M5.5: the desktop folder picker rides Omarchy's portal chooser (exit contract preserved: picked / nothing-picked / fault), every timer install announces every path it touches first (AIDE note where present, honestly degraded to journald+state where the lane is closed — the unprivileged aide-note lie is caught by read-back), and the independence check keys on the backing disk so btrfs subvolumes of one disk can never pass as two corners (the bee: one disk, / dev 32, /home dev 30). check-destination pairs the measured source size with the destination's free space (pass/warn/refuse/unknown, never a silent number).
